title: The Nutcracker Single Tickets!
seo_title: The Nutcracker Single Tickets in Springfield, MO
description: This is a staging of The Nutcracker by Springfield Ballet, following Clara through a dreamscape of toy soldiers, mischievous mice, waltzing flowers, and the Sugar Plum Fairy, with scenes in the Forest of Snow and the Land of Sweets. Performances run December 17–21, 2026 at the Historic Landers Theatre, and the listing is for December 21, 2026, with the time to be determined. Tickets can be ordered by phone at 417.869.1334 or in person at the theatre box office in Springfield, MO.
